messages:
sam-oncall: noticed a small but persistent TLS handshake spike (~0.6%) for eu->us after the DNS egress-balancer changes at 03:10. opening thread to track remediation + owners.

mira-sre: good catch. any quick logs or query we can look at?

sam-oncall: grepped logs: `tls: handshake error; route=eu->us; dst=54.23.12.9; reason=timeout; retries=3`. added a short sample in the incident doc.

leo-neteng: investigating LB + DNS side. I see the egress balancer flipping between two gateway pools (A/B) and a handful of gateways in pool B returning lower MSS in SYN-ACKs. pattern aligns with the timing of the DNS TTL change.
dan-platform: note the rollout reduced DNS TTL from 60s->5s for faster failover; may have exposed a transient bad pool.
mira-sre: action items: 1) leo to collect pcap + confirm MSS anomaly and link to s3; 2) dan to add a deploy gate to prevent aggressive low-TTL rollouts defaulting to <30s; 3) mira to add per-route handshake-failure metric by DNS-target. due EOD Thu for leo, 48h for dan, next Tue for mira. owners acknowledged?

leo-neteng: ack. capturing pcaps and will upload: s3://redwood-incident/pcaps/1945678901-dns-flap.pcap. will run traceroute+mss analysis and post findings.

dan-platform: ack. I'll change the deploy template to require a risk flag to go below 30s TTL and add an alert that triggers if handshake_fail_rate>0.5% for 10m during TTL rollouts. ETA 48h.

ashley-pm: can we add a customer-facing note template in case the spike persists? owner: ashley-pm, will prepare draft by tomorrow.

mira-sre: mid-term: surface DNS-targeted handshake failures in Console (owner=mira-sre), PR target next Tue. also recommend daily review for 2 weeks for recurring patterns.

leo-neteng: initial pcap analysis: pool B gateways were sending MSS options 536 instead of 1460 causing fragmentation and drops on some paths. quick mitigation: cordon the affected gateways from DNS rotation and enable `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on them.
sam-oncall: what's the safe rollout plan for cordoning + mtuprobe?

leo-neteng: plan: 1) cordon affected gateways from pool B in DNS (immediate), 2) enable mtu_probing on those hosts and observe for 10m, 3) slowly reintroduce via DNS with 60s TTL, 5m observation windows. will coordinate with platform for DNS changes.
dan-platform: I'll block sub-30s TTLs by default and add the deploy-watch playbook. also wiring an automated rollback on this thread if the alert fires.

dns-bot: INC-7203 created: "dns egress pool flap -> tls handshake spike" assigned to leo-neteng, mira-sre.

mira-sre: summary of action items in one line: leo - pcap + cordon+mtu change (EOD Thu); dan - TTL safety gate + alert/playbook (48h); mira - dashboard PR + daily reviews x14; ashley - customer template (tomorrow). keeping thread open 24h after prod stable.

sam-oncall: thanks team. I'll post closure when we've had 24h stable and update the incident doc with links.
